title: dense-performance-evidence
summary: Taxonomy of performance evidence an optimization agent needs, ordered by collection cost and diagnostic power. Maps evidence types to the questions they answer and the claims they can support. Use to decide which evidence to collect next, avoid over-claiming from cheap evidence, and structure a measurement campaign.
